definitions.explanation: A large migratory water bird, such as the white-fronted goose, that flies to Japan from the north in autumn and leaves in spring, flying in V-shaped or slanting lines. Also read かり in poetry and set phrases.

examples.japanese: {雁|がん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。

examples.english: Wild geese come here in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、{雁|がん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧いった。
examples.english: A flock of wild geese flew south in a line across the sunset sky.

notes:
An autumn season word in haiku. The reading かり is literary and appears in old poems and some compounds; がん is the everyday and zoological reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雁|がん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: a flock of wild geese
- {雁|がん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: wild geese migrate
- {雁行|がんこう}: flying in a slanting line, as geese do

WATCH OUT:
がん is also ⟦{癌|がん}→癌：02629_gan⟧ (cancer), much more common in speech. {雁|がん}もどき, a fried tofu cake, is said to be named for tasting like goose meat.
